event.title: US real GDP growth in Q3 2026?

markets.title: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.0% in Q3 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If real GDP (as measured by the BEA's seasonally adjusted and annualized Advance Estimate) increases by more than 1.0, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market will close at 8:29 AM on the day of the expected release of the data for Q3 2026, or three months following that expected date.
